received_works.body: Hello Kokoro Mingtong Sensei. I was deeply moved when I saw your work, Canari, the other day. Therefore, regarding this request, I would like to ask for Gwynn (Janapese name is ムク) , who also appears in "Legends: Z-A". She's petite and adorable, yet carries a hint of eeriness. Then again, that might be natural for a Ghost-type user. I feel she's the perfect fit for your expression. I look forward to seeing your Kawaii illustrations again.

Hello Kokoro Mingtong Sensei. I love your Kawaii illustrations and am happy to be able to commission you again like this. Now, what I would like to commission you to do is Rosalina from the Super Mario series. She has starry features and I am curious to see how shimmering and beautiful she will be in your works. She has a wide variety of outfits, for example, a biker suit(Mario Kart), an Aurora Dress(Mario Kart Tour), and a Cat Suit(Super Mario 3D World), but we leave it up to you to choose which one you would like to wear. However, if I may venture to tell you, I prefer the Aurora Dress(Mario Kart Tour). I look forward to seeing your more refined work again.

Hello Kokoro Mingtong Sensei. I am extremely delighted to be able to commission you again. I would like to commission you my recent favourite Kawaii girl, Hiro Shinosawa from Gakuen Idolmaster. If you are producing Hiro-chang in the Gakuen Idolmaster, for better or worse, she will always leave a strong impression. She has a variety of outfits, I particularly like the Fancy Dress Party outfit, but you can choose whichever outfit you like. I trust your judgement. I look forward to seeing your Kawaii illustrations again.

Hello Kokoro Mingtong Sensei. If you give priority to another client's request, you can ignore my request. This time I would like to request Kana Arima from "OSHI NO KO" to be drawn by you. She is both an actress and an IDOL singer. Also, Kana-chang is a "Tsundere" girl. I think the subtleties of expression in the character you draw are so wonderful that I think you can portray her delicately and endearingly. I apologize to you for being a serial requester, but if you feel up to it, I would like you to take me up on the request.

Hello Kokoro Mingtong Sensei. This time I would like to commission you to be one of my favourite girls these days, Bocchi-chang(Hitori Gotoh) from "Bocchi the Rock!". She has pink hair, which you will probably like. I look forward to seeing your wonderful artworks again.

Hello Kokoro Mingtong Sensei. I wanted to make a request to you during this commission-free campaign. I wanted to see your "Tsundere" girl again. Therefore, what I would like to request from you is Mikoto Misaka from A Certain Scientific Railgun. I would like you to draw a cool and dynamic illustration of Mikoto Misaka activating her railgun ability. I look forward to seeing your wonderful artworks again.

Hello Kokoro Mingtong Sensei. I am so happy to request from you again. I want your cute and "Tsundere" Fuyuko Mayuzumi from "Idol Master Shiny Colors". You can choose and draw any of the costume if you like. I look forward to seeing your wonderful artworks.
また、彼女は「墓場」でのお茶会のイメージが強いのですが、どのシーンを描くかはお任せしたいと思います。
前回の続きをお願いします！
